      "evidence": "Primary change is updating release notes, startup help, and RPC help text to correct privacy claims.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Corrects overstated privacy guarantees in documentation and release notes that could lead users into assuming absolute origin concealment. As noted in the release notes, 'The 31.0 release notes overstated these privacy guarantees', fitting the category's top priority for wrong documentation around security and configuration."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Private Broadcast label and defines user-facing privacy expectations for transaction broadcast.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Clarifies the privacy expectations for private transaction broadcast and marks the feature as experimental. However, as noted in the release notes, 'This documentation correction does not change transaction broadcast behavior', making it a worthwhile clarification without altering P2P networking logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/rpc/mempool.cpp only modify the RPC help description text without changing method behavior, parameters, or return values.",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Help text updates that do not alter RPC interfaces or behavior belong under documentation rather than RPC."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/init.cpp solely adjust help text and warning strings for the -privatebroadcast option.",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Settings changes whose focus is entirely another area's behavior are excluded from utils."
